# Scenario: proxy.target.service-name may match compose container_name; runtime
# name is still compose-project based (container_name is stripped before start).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: container_name as proxy target'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web
# Fixed container_name must not appear as the Docker Name.
exec sh -c '! docker ps -a --format "{{.Names}}" | grep -qx fixed-e2e-web'

exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
# Nginx reaches YAML service key on apinfra_proxy_net, not the stripped container_name.
grep 'web\.apinfra_e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf
! grep 'fixed-e2e-web' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-web.conf

exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml
! grep 'container_name' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: fixed-e2e-web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    container_name: fixed-e2e-web
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
